title: KLAAD: Refining Attention Mechanisms to Reduce Societal Bias in Generative Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component dedicated to evaluating and benchmarking religious bias in LLMs. It specifically analyzes 'Religious Ideology' as a bias category, providing detailed evaluation results for several faiths including Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Sikhism, and Atheism using benchmarks like BOLD and StereoSet.
